purpose: Add the Sprint S1.1 phase-current and sensing-range requirements to the existing PB-02 heavy-lift baseline without reopening any PB-02 value.

change_control.rule: PB-03 inherits every PB-01/PB-02 frozen decision. Any later change to a PB-03 frozen value requires PB-04 or an explicitly linked engineering change record; no silent overwrite is allowed.

summary: X8 coaxial / eight independent propulsion channels
18S 66.6 V nominal convention / 75.6 V full charge / <=80 V outer input ceiling
>=70 A continuous DC and >=200 A for >=3 s DC capability
>=4.8 kW continuous and >=11.5 kW short-duration input capability
power-up/reset DISARMED and no automatic re-arm after fault

new_frozen_decisions.rationale: X13 G2 rated-class torque point modeled with source-backed 45KV/42-pole electrical-constant bounds gives <=105.5 A RMS; a 15% model/design allowance gives 121.3 A RMS and is rounded upward to 125 A RMS.

The published X13 G2 maximum torque point maps to <=236.8 A RMS with the conservative torque constant. A 10% allowance gives 260.4 A RMS, rounded to 265 A RMS; sinusoidal peak is 374.8 A, rounded to 375 A.
The phase-current measurement chain must not saturate at the 375 A instantaneous design peak. Exact shunt/CSA implementation and hardware OCP threshold remain open for G2/S1.4.

remaining_s1_critical_open_items: exact 150 V MOSFET MPN and parallel count
current-sense implementation, DC-link, precharge and thermal architecture
anti_hallucination_rule: PB-03 phase-current values are conservative design requirements derived from reference motor/propulsion evidence. They are not measured phase currents of the final motor, U1 inverter, coaxial vehicle or flight article.
